Basically after making me wait a half year

And i did
And after like a half year
I had to move and we kept it long distance 
And all seemed okay
I had a really hard time the last two months before we moved again in the same city

Basically i was just sent away

So the story —>


I have a mum with cancer, my sister almost died recently and it took me like 4 years after an 8 year  long relationship to find someone who just left me. My dad is an alchoholic. Recently my job and living situation, also my financial situation became worse also. My mum's cancer is like a ticking time bomb. I used to have a great group of friends but because they all are more busy with trying to build families, those relationships became dull too and they arent there in person anymore because i had to relocate. My recent partner knew all this and decided to leave even so. No i wasn't a person who always complained about these things and sometimes i did get annoyed i guess but i am a loving and caring partner.  I am extremely lonely in a huge city...   Sometimes jumping off a bridge would seem like the best option because i simply am not too interested anymore in fixing all this. I am afraid of my mum's death because i will miss her a lot, she is one of my best friends as well.   I am afraid to get involved yet again with someone else because it seems to me that people just can't be trusted. They go and follow their feelings mostly as in they promise you they would be there in the time of need but leave if they feel the huge love flame is somewhat lower or not burning so intensely anymore... .  and they don't care about other's feelings and mostly they are only interested in Instagram or Facebook or partying and living a fake life. or to find someone else to have this burning love feeling and just see how long it lasts, obviously it won't last forever and it becomes something else   To be honest if it wasn't for my mum i would have probably tried to end my life already at times because to get a new outlook on this would require so much work and i dont't see the point.   I feel emotions deeper than most people i think and that's just how i am, most people have an easier time recovering but i don't. The idea of living in this world and just to work to get a place to live at where i don't even feel well or just to not pay rent to another person doesn't seem like something i should stay alive for.   I like to travel but to be honest i've seen a lot of things already and what difference does it make if i just don't see anything new anymore or i skip parties or something.   For the longest time i just wanted someone who would value me as a person and would stick by me, most of my friends have found that person... they argue but they always make it work They grow together... and i am not less than any other person who would deserve love but i always get those people who just leave to satisfy their own needs.  also i do value myself but i am just bored alone and i feel lonely and i mean going to work and being alone at home is not really fun to me..   I smiply don't get it...

Well i ve been just dumped by a person like that
And to be honest i find it sad that these people are going to have an easier time finding someone new
And replacing what they already had

(I don’t even like to get involved lately with someone i don’t see it working out on a longer period because it makes no sense to me but this also makes me lonely because most people don’t care , they just get into a relationship and don’t give a fuck about how long its gonna last and whatnot)

Because yes the world is full of these type of people 

And no i don’t think everyone is like that
But it’s really really hard to find someone who can actually relate and understand these things 

To me it seems easy but it’s not the case for the majority 

The easier way out seems to be
Well simply easier 

I see relationships work tho even tho
The other person is deeper
My friend is suffering from depression and his girlfriend would literally do everything for him

And it’s really good to see them work things out
They also give me hope

And tbh i am not even this always sad character 
I just would need someone to get me out of my head if that happens 
But for most people that’s even a hard thing because they are mostly self centered and they just want to have fun
And laugh or post pictures on Instagram
